research_notes: A reliable pre-arm plus incremental checkpoints creates graceful degradation even if the final tail is lost.
Graceful degradation is not equivalent to a clean pass, preserving conservative boundary classification.
The experimental design therefore separates continuation robustness from strict runtime success.
This distinction will matter when optimizing long-run utilization after the boundary is known.
The current retry has removed workload exhaustion as the dominant known confound.
The remaining decisive observation is whether the invocation reaches and durably closes beyond 14 minutes.
